title: Our trip to Sitges
text: Our tour guide was Jordi, who along with our driver, both did an exceptional job during the entire duration of our trip.  Jordi was very flexible and if we asked him to spend more time at one place and less time in another he made sure that every one of our wishes were satisfied.  That’s the great advantage of having a private tour guide when traveling toma foreign country.
author: Monica_P

title: Tour of Sitges
text: The walk along the water and the walk through town where Julio shared his knowledge about Spain and Sitges. Great tour. Collin was a terrific driver!
author: Sherrie_M

title: Private tour from Barcelona to Sitges.
text: Angela was an amazing tour guide.  We were lucky enough to have her on another tour.  We walked the town and she knew every little detail about the entire town.  I would highly recommend this tour AND Angela.
author: carolschachtman
